name: CWIP Asset Entry
description: CWIP asset capitalisation data entry widget

getLastEvent.description: Returns the last event payload. Split by '|' to parse.

getData.description: Returns all rows as a JSON string.

getSelectedData.description: Returns selected rows as a JSON string.

setData.description: Replaces all rows. Call after retrieving data from the SAC model.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: JSON array of row objects containing assetId, assetClass, and capitalizedMonth.

setCellValue.description: Sets a single cell value and re-renders.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to set. Capitalized Month should use YYYY-MM.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: JSON array of dropdown values or objects containing value and text.

setOptions.description: Sets the available Asset Class dropdown options.

onReady.description: Fires when the widget is mounted. Use it to initialize data and dropdown options.

onDataChange.description: Fires when Load Data, Save Changes, row selection, or Clear is used. Read getLastEvent() to identify the action.

onFieldChange.description: Fires when Asset Class or Capitalized Month is changed.

onValidate.description: Fires when Validate is clicked. getLastEvent() returns VALID|0 or INVALID|n.

onClear.description: Fires when editable values are cleared.
